description: SIGONELLA, Sicily (May 21, 2016) A P-3 Orion maritime patrol aircraft from Patrol Squadron (VP) Four from Naval Air Station Sigonella, Sicily conducts search operations for Egyptair flight MS804. The U.S. Navy is providing a P-3 Orion in support of the Egyptian Navy, for assistance in the search of the missing Egyptian aircraft. (U.S. Navy video by Christopher Knapp/Released)
